name: c-emoji-picker-1
title: Inline emoji picker
label: Inline
description: The full picker inline on a card: search, category tabs, the grid and a footer with the preview and skin tone.

guidance.bestFor: The default panel with no composed parts, always open in a card and holding one controlled value with no trigger
agentNotes: The pick only lands in local `value` state; save it from `onValueChange` or pass `name` so a native form submits it

whenNotToUse.when: A panel whose names and labels follow the reader's language

name: c-emoji-picker-2
title: Chat composer
label: Chat Composer
description: A chat composer that inserts emoji at the caret and keeps the draft in view.

guidance.bestFor: A bubble thread that scrolls to each send, where your follow-ups join your last bubble group
agentNotes: `send` only appends to local `groups` state seeded from `THREAD`; post the message to your backend there

whenNotToUse.when: Replies that also offer the team's own uploaded image set
A composer that completes a typed colon code from a list under the field

name: c-emoji-picker-3
title: Message reactions
label: Message Reactions
description: A product update with reactions you can toggle, a tooltip naming who reacted and a picker that opens on quick reactions.

guidance.bestFor: Reaction pills split by skin tone with counts, plus a row of 6 one click reactions composed above the search
agentNotes: `toggle` only rewrites local `reactions` state seeded from `INITIAL_REACTIONS`; send each add or removal to your API there
`QuickReactions` calls `useEmojiPicker`, so it only works rendered inside `EmojiPicker`, where it shares the skin tone and recent list

name: c-emoji-picker-4
title: Page icon
label: Page Icon
description: A page header with an emoji icon above the title, plus Random and Remove in the picker.

guidance.bestFor: A large stored glyph that is its own trigger, swapping to an Add icon button once removed, echoed in the breadcrumb
agentNotes: `icon` is seeded with a sample value in local state; load the page's stored icon there and persist changes from `setIcon`

whenNotToUse.when: A choice that stays open on the page with no button in front of it

name: c-emoji-picker-5
title: Custom team emoji
label: Custom Team Emoji
description: A release thread whose reply field inserts the workspace's own emoji as shortcodes from their own tab.

guidance.bestFor: Image tiles under a logo tab ordered ahead of Frequently used, stored as colon codes and drawn back as images in posts
agentNotes: Replace `TEAM_EMOJI` and its `glyph` data URIs with your workspace's uploads; `src` takes any image URL
A pick stores the first of `shortcodes` as a colon code while `BY_CODE` finds images by `id`, so keep each list starting with its id
Stored posts keep custom picks as colon codes; render them through `renderText` or readers see the raw codes

whenNotToUse.when: Replies that need only the standard Unicode set with no uploaded images

name: c-emoji-picker-6
title: Shortcode suggestions
label: Shortcode Suggestions
description: A design review reply where typing a colon shortcode shows emoji suggestions under the field.

guidance.bestFor: A combobox list of 5 ranked matches driven by arrow keys, Tab or Enter, plus an instant swap of a closed colon code
agentNotes: `DRAFT` seeds the field mid shortcode so suggestions show on load; start from an empty string and drop the `useEffect` that places its caret
Suggestions search raw `data.emojis` from `useEmojiPickerData`, so they skip the grid's check that hides emoji the device cannot draw
`post` only appends to local `comments` state; send the comment to your API there

whenNotToUse.when: A composer that inserts only from the popover grid, with no typed codes

name: c-emoji-picker-7
title: Workplace-safe set
label: Workplace-Safe Set
description: A kudos card whose picker hides a blocklist and newer emoji, then posts the note to #platform.

guidance.bestFor: Browse tabs without nature, food, travel or flags for a textarea that spaces each pick off its neighbors, with Undo after posting
agentNotes: `BLOCKED` holds emojibase hexcode ids such as 1F4A9; edit it to change what `workplaceSafe` removes from browse and search
`send` only flips local `sent` state to show the note back; post the kudos to your API there and retract it in `undo`

name: c-emoji-picker-8
title: Localized data and labels
label: Localized Labels
description: A status emoji card in German, French or Japanese, with localized emoji names, keywords and labels.

guidance.bestFor: A language select that swaps the emoji data and the picker's labels and clears the search, in a panel fitted to the card inset
agentNotes: `locale` loads emoji names, keywords and category labels, while the search, skin tone, empty and loading strings come from `i18n`, so a new language needs both
The `NativeSelect` handler clears the controlled `query` with each switch, since a word in one language finds nothing in another

whenNotToUse.when: An English only panel with no language switch
